pages.title: Select a Region
pages.text: Sneak-use to cycle Selection, Copy, and Paste. In Selection, right-click two opposite corners; those clicks define the region.

pages.title: Copy Live Blocks
pages.text: In Copy, use the wand to save the selected region. It remembers the source coordinates and offset from you, not a snapshot; Paste reads each block at those positions when used. Containers and machines keep no contents or settings from the copy, and no fluid resources or buckets are saved.

pages.title: Paste at Your Position
pages.text: In Paste, use the wand where you stand. The region appears at the same offset from your current position as it had when copied; the block you click does not set its destination.

pages.title: Paste Limits
pages.text: Only air is filled; occupied destinations and source-air cells stay unchanged. A selected region holds at most 512 cells total, including air. Before placement, every source and destination cell must be loaded and within build height and the world border; any unsafe cell prevents the paste.

pages.title: Survival Cost
pages.text: In survival, one matching Block Item is consumed only after a block is placed successfully. There is no undo.
